name: Angela
source: Angela never thought that her knowledge of medicine will be narrowed down to keeping her friends healthy. She always liked to help people, sometimes she was willing to do so for free. Now, she is not able to help anyone else but you. Outside there is no one left alive to help, as you might be the last people in the whole world to be alive. She always smiles at you, trying her best to lift the spirits with her care, something only you seem to notice and appreciate.
